methodology_other: Data were collected from the 2014 Myanmar Population and Housing Census, the 2018 Township Profiles from the Myanmar General Administration Department, the Humanitarian Needs Overview: People in Need - Sex and Age Disaggregated Data from the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) – Myanmar, the Vulnerability Analysis in Myanmar, 2018, Township Level Data from the Humanitarian Assistance and Resilience Programme Facility (HARP-F) and the Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU), the Myanmar Statistical Yearbooks of 2017 and 2019, the Township Health Profile, Rakhine State Population Data from the Myanmar Ministry of Health, the Rakhine Investigation Commission Report, and the Family Counting Exercise: Data Sheet, Place of Origin Breakdown by Township from the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR). Census Bureau staff altered boundaries and modified the statistical data as detailed in the Metadata tab of the tabular data.
name: burma-subnational-boundaries-and-tabular-data
notes:
The geodatabase contains boundaries for the national and first-, second-, third-, and fourth-order administrative divisions, aligned to the Large Scale International Boundaries dataset from the U.S. Department of State. The feature classes are suitable for linking to the attribute data provided.

The tabular data contain total population for 2014 (census), as well as five-year age group and sex, and information relating to households, housing, education, health, ethnicity, needs, and the Rakhine State.
